literal: By the nature of the soil, water changes and becomes like that; for people, wisdom becomes of the nature of their association.
translation: Just as water changes its character depending on the nature of the soil it flows through, so does a person's wisdom take on the character of the company they keep.
modern: நிலத்தின் தன்மையால் நீர் தன் குணம் மாறுபடுவதைப் போல, மனிதர்களின் அறிவு அவர்கள் சேரும் கூட்டத்தின் தன்மையைப் பொறுத்து அமையும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a beautiful analogy from nature to explain the influence of association on human character. Water is naturally pure and colorless, but it takes on the taste, color, and quality of the soil over which it flows. Similarly, human minds and intellects, though inherently neutral, are deeply shaped by the nature of the people they associate with. Therefore, to maintain good character and wisdom, one must choose virtuous and noble companions.
